name: Naval Staff Briefings
author: Local campaign mod
description: 24 rewritten campaign decisions covering diplomacy, procurement, fleet readiness and the economy. Original conditions and mechanical outcomes are preserved. Events that ended in 1999 now run to 2050, and 13 modern events (1950-2050) cover oil crises, missile tests, satellites, piracy, cyber intrusions, missile arms talks, freedom-of-navigation patrols, drone boats, shipyard automation, nuclear port visits, hypersonic missiles, space programmes and defence reviews. Six Cold War events (1947-1990): a blockaded city, a nationalised canal, island missiles, a seized intelligence ship, a grounded submarine and incidents at sea. The game's limit of 100 events is now reached.
